hook: Timothée Lacroix worked on Meta's LLaMA language models as a researcher at Facebook AI Research before leaving in 2023 to co-found Mistral AI with Arthur Mensch and Guillaume Lample. As Chief Technology Officer he leads the Paris-based company's research and technical direction, the work behind models like Mistral Large and the Le Chat assistant. Mistral positioned itself from the outset as a European counterweight to closed, US-based AI labs, releasing open-weight models such as Mistral 7B alongside its commercial offerings. Lacroix trained as a computer scientist at the Ecole Normale Superieure and holds a doctorate tied to the University of Paris-Est.
